full_judgment:
Syed Muhammad Dastagir Husain J: This Rule was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and Order (Annexure-A) dated 24-7-96 passed by the Subordinate Judge, 4th Court and Artha-Rin-Adalat, Comilla in Miscellaneous Case No. 20 of 1990 should not be declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect and or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. Heard the Learned Advocates and perused the application. Mr Md Tofazzal Hossain, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners, submits that the order of transferring the Miscellaneous Case No. 89 of 1987 pending before the District Judge under Article 27 of President's Order 7 of 1973 is without lawful authority and therefore, the consequent Judgment and order passed by the learned Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Comilla is equally without lawful authority and therefore, the impugned order has been passed without any basis. On the other hand, Mr KS Zaman, the learned Advocate appearing for the respondents, submits that in view of the power given in section 27 sub-section 7(D), the District Judge can transfer the case to the Artha Rin Adalat or any other court for trial. 

 3. On perusal of the President's Order 7 of 1973 it appears that the District Judge has been invested with the power to try the case under section 27 of President's Order 7 of 1973 or dispose the same under the President's Order 7 of 1973. He has not been given any power to transfer the case to any other Court for trial. Section 27(7d) of President's Order 7 of 1973 runs as follows: 

 4. This power of passing any other incidental orders does not mean that the District Judge has the power to transfer the Miscellaneous Case to any other court for trial under section 27(7d) of President's Order 7 of 1973 and therefore, the submission made by the learned Advocate Mr KS Zaman that the District Judge has the power to transfer the Miscellaneous 'Case under section 27(7d) is devoid of any substance. Thus, we hold that the very act of transferring the Miscellaneous Case in question by the District Judge to the Court of Artha Rin Adalat and Subordinate Judge for trial was done without lawful authority which is liable to be set aside. This view of ours finds support in the case of Bangladesh House Building Finance Corporation vs Jahan Ara Akhtar & others reported in 49 DLR (AD) 80.
